title: toddalia asiatica var. floribunda
intro: Toddalia asiatica var. floribunda, commonly known as the Indian plum or Chinese plum, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving fever, nausea, and diarrhea, as well as exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Toddalia asiatica var. floribunda are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
